answer: Duplicate keys are slashed, and a forged onyx seal burns the full bond, so running N sybils costs N times the stake plus forfeiture risk. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a hardware root key; joining a new canyon shard requires proving a unique key attestation. Honest peers attest only unique-key proofs, making mass fake identities economically irrational. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
